domain_number_and_name: Domain 1: Skeletal reduction, alignment and symmetry
plain_language_description: ZMC 3D Surface Mesh Congruence & Global Facial Symmetry (Zygomaticomaxillary complex (ZMC), Zygomatic arch, Lateral orbital wall)
proposed_operational_definition: Postoperative 3D surface distance mapping across segmented ZMC surface mesh registered against mirrored uninjured contralateral facial skeleton using Iterative Closest Point (ICP).
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring ZMC 3D Surface Mesh Congruence & Global Facial Symmetry provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Zygomaticomaxillary complex (ZMC), Zygomatic arch, Lateral orbital wall?
proposed_measurement_feasibility_questio: Is the proposed method (Fine-slice multiplanar CT (<= 1.0 mm slice, 0 deg gantry tilt) + Automated 3D mesh surface registration) feasible, reproducible, and objective in routine postoperative clinical workflows?
threshold_decision: NO EXPLICIT THRESHOLD REPORTED (Normal biological asymmetry up to 1.98 mm RMSD is reference control data, not an automatic postoperative pass/fail standard)
potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.

domain_number_and_name: Domain 1: Skeletal reduction, alignment and symmetry
plain_language_description: Vertical and Horizontal Craniofacial Buttress Anatomical Continuity (Zygomaticomaxillary buttress, Nasomaxillary buttress, Pterygomaxillary junction, Frontomaxillary pillar)
proposed_operational_definition: Direct multiplanar radiological assessment of cortical bone alignment, residual gap, and step-off deformity at key buttress contact points.
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Vertical and Horizontal Craniofacial Buttress Anatomical Continuity provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Zygomaticomaxillary buttress, Nasomaxillary buttress, Pterygomaxillary junction, Frontomaxillary pillar?
proposed_measurement_feasibility_questio: Is the proposed method (Multiplanar high-resolution CT (axial, coronal, sagittal reformations, bone algorithm kernel)) feasible, reproducible, and objective in routine postoperative clinical workflows?
threshold_decision: NO EXPLICIT THRESHOLD REPORTED (Textbook establishes qualitative anatomical principles; no statistical millimeter reduction cutoff reported)
potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.

domain_number_and_name: Domain 2: Orbital reconstruction and ophthalmic outcomes
plain_language_description: Internal Bony Orbital Volume Restoration (Orbital floor, Medial orbital wall, Inferior orbital rim)
evidence_references_and_verification_lev: CANON-RES-EVD-003 (PAP-003), CANON-RES-EVD-005 (PAP-005) [full text (PAP-003 PMC504888) / abstract only (PAP-005)]
proposed_operational_definition: Postoperative difference in bony orbital volume between reconstructed orbit and contralateral unaffected orbit (Delta mL = Volume_reconstructed - Volume_contralateral).
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Internal Bony Orbital Volume Restoration provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Orbital floor, Medial orbital wall, Inferior orbital rim?
proposed_measurement_feasibility_questio: Is the proposed method (Multiplanar fine-slice CT (<= 1.0 mm slices) with slice-by-slice planimetry or deep learning volumetric segmentation) feasible, reproducible, and objective in routine postoperative clinical workflows?
threshold_decision: NO EXPLICIT THRESHOLD REPORTED (1.0 mL is a continuous predictive regression ratio [1.0 mL = 0.8 mm enophthalmos], NOT a universal standalone binary pass/fail cutoff)
potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.

domain_number_and_name: Domain 2: Orbital reconstruction and ophthalmic outcomes
plain_language_description: Clinical Globe Projection & Enophthalmos (Orbital floor, Medial orbital wall, ZMC complex)
evidence_references_and_verification_lev: CANON-RES-EVD-004 (PAP-004), CANON-ATLAS-CH19-EVD-004 [abstract only (PAP-004) / full text (Atlas Ch. 19)]
proposed_operational_definition: Direct clinical measurement of anterior corneal projection relative to lateral orbital rim using Hertel exophthalmometry, or 3D multiplanar CT axial globe protrusion comparison.
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Clinical Globe Projection & Enophthalmos provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Orbital floor, Medial orbital wall, ZMC complex?
proposed_measurement_feasibility_questio: Is the proposed method (Hertel exophthalmometer (clinical) and/or Multiplanar CT axial slice through lens/optic nerve) feasible, reproducible, and objective in routine postoperative clinical workflows?
threshold_decision: NO EXPLICIT THRESHOLD REPORTED (Clinical consensus defines enophthalmos as >2.0 mm recession; source documents linear relationships without binary success boundary)
potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.

domain_number_and_name: Domain 2: Orbital reconstruction and ophthalmic outcomes

proposed_operational_definition: Structured binocular visual field evaluation recording presence, gaze direction (primary, downward/reading, extreme periphery), and severity of double vision.
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Postoperative Diplopia & Ocular Motility Field provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Orbital floor, Medial wall, Orbital apex?
proposed_measurement_feasibility_questio: Is the proposed method (Goldmann perimetry, Hess screen, Binocular Single Vision (BSV) score, or structured clinical motility exam) feasible, reproducible, and objective in routine postoperative clinical workflows?

potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.

plain_language_description: Maximal Interincisal Opening (MIO) & Functional Mobility (Mandibular condyle, Subcondyle, Angle, Ramus, Body, Symphysis)
proposed_operational_definition: Interincisal distance between maxillary and mandibular central incisor edges at maximum comfortable and active jaw opening, measured in millimeters.
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Maximal Interincisal Opening (MIO) & Functional Mobility provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Mandibular condyle, Subcondyle, Angle, Ramus, Body, Symphysis?

plain_language_description: Static and Dynamic Dental Occlusal Restoration (Mandibular fractures, Maxillary fractures, Le Fort I/II/III, Dentoalveolar injuries)

proposed_operational_definition: Clinical evaluation of intercuspation reproducibility, absence of premature contacts, preservation of pre-traumatic wear facets, and dental midline alignment.
clinical_relevance_question: Does measuring Static and Dynamic Dental Occlusal Restoration provide critical, clinically meaningful evidence of treatment success or failure in Mandibular fractures, Maxillary fractures, Le Fort I/II/III, Dentoalveolar injuries?

potential_sources_of_bias_or_confounding: Confounded by pre-existing asymmetry, bilateral injuries, patient compliance, timing of scan, or metal artifact.
